name: Heavy-rain and urban flooding – southern Ontario

geo.extent: Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area and southern Ontario

description: Southern Ontario had a "summer of floods" in 2024; on 16 July 97.8 mm fell at Toronto Pearson. Intense rain over paved cities produces basement and road flooding.

practical_implications: Basement flooding; transit and highway disruption

sources.title: Canada's 10 most impactful weather stories of 2024
Canada's Changing Climate Report (2019) – Headline statements
sources.publisher: Government of Canada (Environment and Climate Change Canada, lead)
sources.methodology: Assessment report; statements are assessments of observed and projected change, not local forecasts

verification.notes: Event facts quoted or paraphrased from the cited official pages on 2026-10-30. Exposure and implications are agent-04 interpretation.

limitations: Single season. Past events show exposure; they are not a prediction for any particular year. Exposure varies street by street – check municipal and provincial hazard maps for a specific property.
